A.name: A
A.query:
WITH
  toInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) AS end_ms,
  series AS (
    SELECT fingerprint,
           any(if(JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name') != '', JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name'), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.id'))) AS host,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'state')) AS state,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'role')) AS role,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'pool')) AS pool
    FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4
    WHERE metric_name IN ('loom.forge.stage_items', 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent')
    GROUP BY fingerprint
  ),
  pts AS (
    SELECT series.host AS host, series.state AS state, series.role AS role, series.pool AS pool,
           s.metric_name AS metric, s.unix_milli AS ms, s.value AS value
    FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4 AS s
    INNER JOIN series USING (fingerprint)
    WHERE s.metric_name IN ('loom.forge.stage_items', 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent')
      AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}}
      AND s.unix_milli < {{.end_timestamp_ms}}
  ),
  per_host AS (
    SELECT host,
           maxIf(value, metric = 'loom.forge.stage_items' AND state IN ('triage', 'unlabeled', 'curated_not_promoted', 'issue_no_pr')) AS stage_items,
           maxIf(value, metric = 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent') AS max_concurrent
    FROM pts
    WHERE host != ''
    GROUP BY host
  ),
  spawned AS (
    SELECT if(resources_string['host.name'] != '', resources_string['host.name'], resources_string['host.id']) AS host, count() AS n
    FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3
    WHERE name = 'loom.dispatch.step'
      AND attributes_string['loom.dispatch.admission_result'] = 'spawned'
      AND timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64({{.start_timestamp_ms}}))
      AND timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}))
    GROUP BY host
  )
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(end_ms, 1000)) AS ts,
       per_host.host AS host,
       toFloat64(per_host.stage_items) AS value
FROM per_host
LEFT JOIN spawned ON spawned.host = per_host.host
WHERE per_host.max_concurrent > 0
  AND per_host.stage_items > 0
  AND spawned.n = 0
ORDER BY host

annotations.description: Host {{$labels.host}} dispatches (loom.dispatch.max_concurrent > 0) and its repos show {{$value}} items waiting for a step (loom.forge.stage_items in triage, unlabeled, curated_not_promoted or issue_no_pr), but it spawned no loom.dispatch.step in 15 min. Since #11909 the work finder's step tick is the only item dispatch path, so this is dispatch stopped, not slow. Check `loom-daemon health` and the work_finder log for 'step tick' lines and passes; query loom.dispatch.step refusals by loom.dispatch.reason, and pick.decision item_draw for the pools and exclusions. Issue rjwalters/loom#11909.
